notes.note: Reviewed the desktop-build, native-releases, nightly and README runtime/distribution claims against dfc52bf7ff. The sole source change declares frozen maxBytes/maxFiles as readonly numeric limits instead of inferring the literal maxFiles 30000. Values, freezing, release-budget comparisons, dependency placement, Windows path policy, packaging and launch behavior are unchanged. The existing zero-budget diagnostic assertion remains intact and its exact named case passed 1/1 (19 deliberately unselected); npm run typecheck:scripts exited 0, checking 567 of 623 script TypeScript files with the existing 56 deferred. Hosted TS2322 at the zero maxFiles option is the pre-fix failure receipt. No prose change needed and no new Windows native or signed-artifact proof claimed.
